subject: System Design
title: DoorDash's Delivery Optimization
description: A micro-lesson that makes DoorDash's Delivery Optimization usable.

hook.text: A driver picks up orders from 3 restaurants and delivers to 3 customers. The route order matters enormously.

buildup.text: DoorDash batches nearby orders to maximize driver efficiency. One trip, multiple pickups and drop-offs.

discovery.text: Route optimization uses variations of the Traveling Salesman Problem — find the shortest route through all stops.

twist.text: Food gets cold. A perfect route that delivers the last order 45 minutes late is a terrible customer experience.

climax.text: Delivery optimization balances driver efficiency, food freshness, and customer wait time — three competing goals.

punchline.text: Batch orders, optimize routes — but the food can't get cold.

quiz.question: Why can't delivery routes be purely optimized for distance?
options: Food freshness and customer wait time are competing constraints
